company.name: Hospitalia
company.shortDescription: Redefining the future of healthcare, one home at a time
company.description:
Welcome to Hospitalia, the ultimate home healthcare companion designed to redefine the way you access and experience medical care. Our app connects you seamlessly with a diverse range of healthcare services, all conveniently accessible from the comfort of your own home.

Discover the power of Hospitalia as your trusted platform for comprehensive home healthcare services. With just a few taps, you can access a network of skilled doctors, compassionate nurses, experienced physiotherapists, and even top-notch radiology and lab services.

Hospitalia offers a holistic range of integrated home healthcare services, including doctor home visits, nursing care, physiotherapy sessions, and the convenience of having radiology and lab testing brought directly to your doorstep. Experience personalized care tailored to your specific needs, all delivered in the comfort and privacy of your own home.

Our user-friendly interface allows you to effortlessly book appointments, manage your healthcare schedule, and receive timely reminders. Enjoy a seamless and efficient healthcare journey, with no more waiting rooms or unnecessary travel.

Whether you require a medical consultation, ongoing nursing support, therapeutic exercises, or diagnostic tests, Hospitalia has got you covered. Our dedicated team of healthcare providers is committed to delivering the highest quality care, prioritizing your well-being and convenience.

Take control of your health with a trusted companion that brings medical expertise to your doorstep. Experience the future of healthcare service delivery with Hospitalia - your partner in accessible, reliable, and personalized home healthcare.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $125,000, or 60.91% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $30,207, representing 14.72% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $634,821 to $1,202,234, a 1.89x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 61 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 29 (-11).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Strategic repositioning and listing coverage shape the current narrative
insights.statement: Hospitalia has a recent strategic-positioning change; 1 recent unique news titles explicitly contain the English terms IPO or listing.
insights.implication: Their timing coincides with increased visibility in the loaded news and Crunchbase momentum signals, but the data does not establish causation.
caveats: The causal link to Crunchbase momentum is an inference from timing, not a disclosed company metric.

insights.title: IPO intent and modeled likelihood conflict
insights.statement: Recent headline metadata discusses an IPO or listing, while Crunchbase’s model assigns a 0% IPO probability.
insights.implication: Publicly discussed intent should not be treated as proof of execution; the conflict is a useful diligence flag for verifying filing status, timing, and exchange readiness.
caveats: The prediction is an opaque model output and may lag current company plans.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Vezeeta, Altibbi, Nabta Health.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
